senses.gloss: as preced. Hif., to cause to pass; to remove, displace; to cover up.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 65b:1">Ab. Zar. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>מְעַבֵּר להו מעברא</he> he passed them over the ford.
<cite ref="Yoma 33b:2">Yoma 33ᵇ</cite> <he>עַבּוּרֵי דרעא וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="D01118"><he>דְּרָעָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Eruvin 65a:2">Erub. 65ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q00314"><he>פּוּק</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 18a:5">Ḥull. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>שמתיה ועַבְּרֵיה</he> he excommunicated him and removed him (from his office).
Ib. מְעַבְּרִינָן ליה וכ׳ we remove him and declare his meat ṭ’refah.
<cite ref="Berakhot 27b:20">Ber. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>תא ונְעַבְּרֵיה</he> come, let us displace him.

<cite ref="Berakhot 39a:11">Ib. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>לעבורי זוהמא</he> to carry off foul matter. Y. Ber. II, 4ᶜ bot. <he>הוה מעבר וכ׳</he> covered it with a sheet, v. <cite ref="Q01045"><he>פַּלְיוּם</he></cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Yevamot 63b">Yeb. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>עבורו</he>, v. infra.
